dataFlow: git push → .git/hooks/pre-push → Husky Manager (HUSKY=0 check) → .husky/pre-push (bun typecheck) → Bun Runtime (package.json lookup) → Turbo Task Runner (workspace discovery, 16 packages) → TypeScript Compiler (parallel execution, cache) → Exit Code Aggregation (zero tolerance) → Git Decision (allow/block push) → GitHub Webhook (if allowed) → CI Workflow (typecheck.yml) → Branch Protection (merge decision)
